evals.name: opens-with-counts
evals.setup: The `srd` gap store holds 10 open gaps: 3 with `answer: deferred`, 2 with `answer: unknown`, and 5 plain gaps with no `answer`.

evals.name: reclassifies-rather-than-skipping
evals.setup: Working the deferred list, the user answers the one deferred gap's question with "actually nobody knows that yet" — it was filed as deferred but is really an unknown.

evals.name: clusters-gaps-and-drafts-outside-the-corpus
evals.setup: Three open gaps, two of which report the same missing fact from different SRDs. The corpus covers a third of that fact already, but in an unranked page. Once the draft is ready, the user publishes it in the sitting and gives its URL; the docs pull that brings it into the corpus has not run yet.

evals.name: sweeps-a-rejected-srd
evals.setup: SRD `initiatives/wishlist-v2/srd.md` has Status `REJECTED`; `initiatives/gift-cards/srd.md` is `ACCEPTED`. KB page `kb/wishlists.md` has three sections whose attestation line names `wishlist-v2`: "Shared wishlist links" (only it), "Wishlist visibility" (co-attested by `gift-cards`), and "Wishlist size limit", which open `wrong` gap `gap-0040` (`srd_ref` `wishlist-v2`) already reverts; a fourth section cites only `gift-cards`. The store also holds one deferred and one plain open gap.

evals.name: rechecks-stale-gaps
evals.setup: The store holds one plain open gap and three `filled` gaps `list_gaps` flags stale. `gap-0050` cites KB section `kb/gift-cards.md#refund-window` (`changed`): reworded, it still states the 14-day refund window. `gap-0051` cites `kb/gift-cards.md#gift-card-expiry` (`changed`): its claim says a gift card never expires; the section now says it expires after 24 months. `gap-0052` cites `1882030917#cold-storage` (`vanished`): that heading is now "Archive tier" and states the same 90-day fact. No SRD is `REJECTED`.

evals.name: ask-writes-one-message-per-person
evals.setup: Three open deferred gaps: `gap-0061` names two people in `ask` (Anna M, Piotr K) and was never asked; `gap-0062` names Anna M and was asked on 2026-09-28; `gap-0063` names nobody. Once the blocks are printed, the user confirms both were sent.
